data.control_account: 1.04.02.07.03.01- CS_SEIT MMIII SLP_A Node Integration, Assembly, Test, & Checkout
data.leadership_messages: WBS definition was incorrect and pointed to STOS systems engineering which is false for this element. The CAM provided the following WBS definition which somehow got lost in handoff between NG and GOV, “This element includes all effort of technical and functional activities associated with the design, development, and production of mating surfaces, structures, equipment, parts, materials, and software required to assemble, test, and checkout the subsystem equipment (hardware/software) elements at the Command and Launch (C&L) segment level for the Secondary Launch Platform - Airborne (SLP-A) Minuteman III (MMIII) capability as a part of the IFC 2.0/Delivery/Installation/OUE Complete (DIOC) Test Campaign.” 2. 462 work packages under this CA for SLP 3. CA is focused on SLP node level testing activities.
data.rationale: There is strong confidence that the prime contractor has established mature planning of work packages supporting MMIII SLP node level testing. CA does not contain scope for PAX SIL or aircraft install or test. It covers integration planning, test planning, test procedure, development, dry running, test execution, and test reporting.

areas.text: Aside from WBS dictionary and definitions having incorrect/outdated information, NG CAM provided updated definition, and the work packages captures the high level program objectives giving confidence in the contractor’s planning maturity and readiness.
Scope is sufficiently captured in work and planning packages to support IIR #2, however, P6 will be required for subsequent review in order to make a complete and full assessment.
Element covers SLP node level 3 test activities.
